one_pot_steps: Stage 1, palladium-catalysed carbonylation of 式(IV)化合物 with CO and cyclohexane-1,3-dione over PdCl2 and 1,4-bis(diphenylphosphino)butane with triethylamine in 1,4-dioxane, run at 80 to 85 C under CO at about 1 to 4 MPa for about 8 h

Stage 2, acetone-cyanohydrin-promoted rearrangement of that enol ester to the 2-acyl-1,3-dione tembotrione, the batch cooled to 70 C, the acetone cyanohydrin added and the reaction continued for 5 h, with no workup and no isolation between the two stages

procedure_text: 向高压釜中加入式(IV)化合物56.84g、三乙胺37.95g、PdCl2催化剂0.4g、配体1,4-双(二苯基膦)丁烷3.98g、溶剂1,4-二氧六环300g，抽真空，氮气置换3次，以约1～4MPa的压力通入CO，在80～85℃反应约8h后降温至70℃，加入2g丙酮氰醇，继续反应5h。通过高效液相色谱监测反应完成后，降至室温，卸去压力，打开反应釜，过滤，除去三乙胺氢溴酸盐，旋蒸除去溶剂二氧六环，加入甲醇水溶解，用氢氧化钠溶液调节pH至8～9，加热至50℃搅拌，过滤掉不溶物，调酸至pH为2～3，析出白色固体，将溶液冷却到室温并冰浴搅拌0.5h，过滤，水洗，过滤，60℃干燥，得到黄白色粉末状固体环磺酮，收率64.67％，熔点120～122℃。
procedure_summary: In one pot, the aryl bromide of formula (IV) is carbonylated under CO pressure over a palladium chloride catalyst with a bisphosphine ligand and triethylamine in dioxane, and the resulting ester is rearranged in the same vessel by adding acetone cyanohydrin without isolation. The triethylamine hydrobromide by-product is filtered off, the solvent stripped, and tembotrione recovered by dissolving in aqueous methanol, basifying, filtering off insolubles and reprecipitating with acid.
